ptr.note: AVClass-enabled logging context or NULL (general log). Read only: av_vlog reads the class's version and log_level_offset_offset (then the int at that offset), format_line reads class_name/item_name, parent_log_context_offset (then the parent pointer and its class) and get_category. Borrowed for the call; the installed callback receives it unchanged. Rust: a LogContext (an ObjectRef converts into one; Record::context hands a callback the one it receives). [symbol] va_list consumed through av_vbprintf's va_copy only, so the caller's va_list stays usable. Static state (print_prefix, repeat count, prev line) under a non-recursive static mutex; prints to stderr. Rust exposes it as Record::log_default inside a callback, where a live va_list exists.
